# HT Mobile Tire

> On-demand mobile tire service bringing professional tire mounting, balancing, puncture repairs, and seasonal changeovers directly to your driveway, workplace, or roadside across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario.

## Core Information
- Website: https://www.htmobiletire.com
- Dispatch Phone: +1 (647) 995-6665
- Service Hours: 24/7 emergency roadside assistance and daily scheduled on-site mobile appointments.
- Operating Model: Fully equipped mobile tire service vans dispatched directly to the customer's vehicle location.

## Primary Services
1. New and Used Tires
   - Quality new brand-name tires and certified inspected used tires delivered, mounted, and balanced on-site.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/services/new-used-tires

2. Swap Rim Tire On/Off
   - Seasonal tire changeover service for winter, summer, and all-season tires on or off rims.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/services/swap-rim-tire

3. Wheel Balancing
   - Computerized laser dynamic wheel balancing to eliminate steering vibration, improve highway smoothness, and prevent uneven tread wear.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/services/wheel-balancing

4. Flat Tire Repair
   - On-site puncture assessment, radial tire patching, bead leak resealing, and vulcanization for road hazards.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/services/flat-tire-repair

5. Fleet Tire Service
   - Turnkey scheduled mobile maintenance and emergency support for commercial delivery vans, corporate fleets, and light trucks.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/services/fleet-tire-service

6. 24/7 Emergency Roadside Tire Assistance
   - Rapid on-demand roadside response for blowouts, flats, and emergency spare tire installations.
   - URL: https://www.htmobiletire.com/emergency
